title: One person shot dead by police, another injured near Keremeos
subtitle: RCMP officers tried to arrest two people wanted on outstanding warrants in the 4100-block Highway 3 near Keremeos Tuesday morning.
article: One man is dead and a woman is seriously injured after they were shot by police near Keremeos.
B.C. RCMP said members of an emergency response team tried to arrest a man and woman wanted on outstanding warrants in the 4100-block of Highway 3 near Keremeos at around 7:45 a.m. Tuesday.
Mounties allege that as they were trying to arrest the pair, the man produced a weapon and was shot by police.
"The incident continued," said RCMP, and the woman was also shot.
The man died at the scene, while the woman was taken to hospital in serious condition.
Police did not say what the weapon was, but notes that "due to potential dangers at the location," an RCMP explosives unit has been called in.

The Independent Investigations Office of B.C. has been notified. The civilian-led police oversight office is tasked to investigate interactions with police that result in death or serious injury, regardless of whether there is an allegation of wrongdoing.
